<infobox theme="swordform">
    <image source="image">
        <default>Hilt-icon-color.svg</default>
    </image>
	<title source="name">
	    <default>{{PAGENAME}}</default>
	</title>
	<data source="mentioned">
	    <label>First mentioned or used</label>
	</data>
	<data source="used">
	    <label>Mentioned or used by</label>
	</data>
	<navigation>[[Template:Character|[Source]]]</navigation>
</infobox><includeonly>[[Category:Sword forms]]</includeonly><!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE. In order to regenerate the template, replace the code above with the source code provided. --><noinclude>__NOTOC__
{{clear}}

__NOTOC__
{{clear}}
===Field list===
<pre>
{{ swordform 
| mentioned = Book and chapter form was mentioned (use <nowiki>{{book #|chapter #</nowiki>).
| used = Character or characters who used the form. You will need to link each individual character.
}}
</pre>

===Example===
<pre>
{{swordform 
| mentioned={{2|1}}
| used=[[Rand al'Thor]]
}}</pre>

===Usage===
Paste the following code into the top of an article, filling all known fields. Remove any unused fields.
<pre><nowiki>{{swordform 
| mentioned=
| used=
}}</nowiki></pre>
